{{Quote|But you can't fight shadows, not in the dark&hellip;|Alain Gryphon's final words before dying in the growing chamber|<ref name="Otherspace">''[[Otherspace (adventure)|Otherspace]]''</ref>}}
The '''growing chamber''' was a room aboard the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Desolate]]''. It was on the first of the vessel's four platforms and was built around its [[Power core/Legends|power core]]. Pods grew from the chamber's floor and walls to fill the chamber; these pods had stony peels and thorny tendrils that formed canopied paths between their irregularly-spaced rows. Each pod was filled with a thick yellow paste. Thin tendrils also grew out of the power core and sucked up the paste from broken pods.<ref name="Otherspace" />

When the [[Mutiny on the Celestial|escaped]] [[Prisoner/Legends|inmates]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]] ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]'' ended up in [[Otherspace]] and began [[Skirmish on the Desolate|exploring]] ''Desolate'', they made a reckless passage through the growing chamber, crushing a number of tendrils and pods. Thorny roots tore at their [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], and their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were fired at the growths. The ''Celestial''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Alain Gryphon]], succumbed to [[Charon venom|poison]] and was left to [[Death/Legends|die]] inside the growing chamber. The crew of another Rebel [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Long Shot]]'', arrived and heard her dying words. They then continued on into the next room: an overlook.<ref name="Otherspace" />
